item.title: Tell HN: I Bought a Pocket Notebook
item.summary: I realized I was using taskwarrior, joplin and habitica. All for different stuff. It ends today, I bought a pocket notebook, a page is a day. Formats and ways to go about documenting things will be mine to create. I feel better already. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49251663 Points: 3 # Comments: 1
